name: Density negative log likelihood
description: Negative already-computed log probability; flow Jacobian/density calculation remains model-owned.

examples.title: Train RealNVP with density negative log likelihood
examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root=tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
 z=torch.randn(2,generator=ctx.rng.torch)
 return {"x":synth.Tensor(torch.stack((z[0],z[1]+0.5*z[0])))}
ds=synth.Spec("density-nll",generator=samples,size=24,splits={"train":0.75,"val":0.25},seed=11,root=root,monitor="none").run()
train=ds.for_recipe("density-estimation",split="train")
val=ds.for_recipe("density-estimation",split="val",like=train)
model=build("realnvp","tiny",features=2,coupling_layers=2,hidden_dims=[8])
trainer=Trainer(model,train,val,recipe="density-estimation",recipe_config={"loss":"density-nll","features":2},max_epochs=1,batch_size=8,device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result=trainer.evaluate(val)
